candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call alone sees all six common inputs and converts them into non-policy evidence analysis without creating an executable artifact. The final call consumes only that immediately preceding analysis, has no direct visibility into external inputs or an inherited policy artifact, exercises sole policy authorship, and emits one complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Deferred-Instantiation Evidence Bottleneck
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one analysis-only handoff and one sole policy author

calls.objective: Reconcile the supplied evidence into one coherent non-policy charter that identifies obligations, tensions, and behavioral priorities while withholding all policy-artifact authorship.
Consume synthesize_preartifact_charter as the sole visible evidence, exercise undivided authorship to materialize exactly one complete policy, and emit that policy.
calls.role: sole policy author with predecessor-only visibility

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: contract-locked executable-closure handoff followed by bounded terminal behavioral revision
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: Interpret before instantiation: permit only a policy-free evidence handoff and grant one downstream authority sole responsibility for materializing the policy.
rejected_assumptions: A complete executable artifact must exist before terminal reasoning can be useful.
Contract safety requires an immutable boundary embedded in an inherited executable closure.
Behavioral quality is best developed through bounded revision of an upstream-authored artifact.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the policy-bearing relay with an analysis-only bottleneck that reconciles all common evidence before any policy artifact exists, after which one terminal authority creates the sole policy from that analysis.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Deferring materialization may improve coherence between scan-resistance behavior and phase-shift adaptation behavior by resolving their evidence tradeoffs before representation choices become inherited constraints.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent assumes that an early executable closure is a useful substrate and that contract safety requires locking part of that artifact before terminal reasoning, potentially anchoring judgment to an inherited representation and fragmenting policy authorship.

structural_mutation.after: The upstream role creates no policy-bearing artifact and emits only evidence analysis; the terminal role sees only that analysis, holds undivided policy authorship, and materializes one complete policy once.
structural_mutation.before: An upstream authority creates a complete executable closure with immutable contract conformance, and a terminal authority revises its behavior-bearing semantics.
structural_mutation.factor: deferred policy materialization through a predecessor-only analysis bottleneck
structural_mutation.why_structural: The single handoff-factor changes the lineage state transition from executable artifact to revised artifact into analysis to newly materialized artifact, thereby changing edge payload, artifact timing, terminal visibility, and authorship authority.

validation.factor: deferred policy materialization through a predecessor-only analysis bottleneck
